Four electric motors do the same quantity of work when they lift a weight of 10N through the
same distance.
The times taken by each motor to lift the weight are shown.
What is the time taken by the motor which produces the most power?
A
1.5s
B
6.0s
C
15s
D
60s
subject: Physics
